Lantern Permit Act

AN ACT relating to fair permits for lanterns.

Section 1. Definitions
(A) "Agency" means any office of [STATE] that issues lantern permits.
(B) "Permit" means a written leave to light a lantern under [appropriate section of the state code].

Drafting Note: A state may rename the agency to fit its code.
It may also add a fee schedule.

Section 2. Permit Timelines
(A) Within ten (10) business days an agency shall decide each application.
Commentary: This section follows an invented study of lantern permits.

(B) An application not decided in time is deemed approved for Fiscal Year [20XX].
[insert effective date]
2
Section 3. Review
A person aggrieved by a violation of this Act may bring an action.
